question: What is the value of 13 × 12 + 12 × 11 - 14 × 15 - 9 × 13 + 19 × 15?
solution:
**Given:**

13 × 12 + 12 × 11 - 14 × 15 - 9 × 13 + 19 × 15

**Formula Used:**

Perform arithmetic operations (multiplication and addition/subtraction).

**Calculation:**

⇒ 13 × 12 + 12 × 11 - 14 × 15 - 9 × 13 + 19 × 15

⇒ 156 + 132 - 210 - 117 + 285

⇒ (156 + 132 + 285) - (210 + 117)

⇒ 573 - 327

⇒ 246

**The value is 246.**
